chunks: Saad narrated from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee' from Ali ibn al-Nu'man from Mansur ibn Hazim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
When a man greets you while you are praying, he said: 'You respond to him quietly, as he said.'
ai.seo_question: How should one respond to a greeting during prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies the practical etiquette of *salam* during prayer, emphasizing that the response should be discreet to maintain the sanctity and focus of the worshipper. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly consensus on balancing social courtesy with the solemnity of *salat*, ensuring the greeting does not disrupt the internal state of *khushu*.
